reason: An automation plugin for DSH Desktop that repairs pnpm command shims, continuously synchronizes desktop and web plugin profiles, and prepares pnpm configuration before installation.

summaries.zh: 自动修复 DSH Desktop 的 pnpm 命令 shim，并将桌面端插件安装、卸载和版本变化同步到 web 端。
summaries.en: Automatically repairs DSH Desktop pnpm command shims and synchronizes plugin installations, removals, and versions from the desktop profile to the web profile.

capabilities: Automatically edits pnpm and Node command shims
Watches desktop plugin manifest files for changes
Synchronizes plugin installations, removals, and versions between desktop and web profiles
Provides status, synchronization, and shim-repair endpoints
